name: dose_prior_pseudo_count
meaning: shrinkage weight toward a multiplier of 1.0 before any feedback exists

name: dose_step_pct
meaning: how much each confirming report nudges a nutrient's dose multiplier (percent)

name: dose_mult_min
meaning: hard floor on the dose multiplier - applied before crop caps so the cap is still the final word

name: dose_mult_max
meaning: hard ceiling on the dose multiplier

name: min_verified_reports_for_yield
meaning: yield-bias recalibration only activates once this many verified reports with an actual yield exist

name: yield_bias_ewma_alpha
meaning: exponential-weighted-moving-average smoothing factor for the yield residual ratio

name: yield_bias_min_pct
meaning: floor on the applied yield bias (percent)

name: yield_bias_max_pct
meaning: ceiling on the applied yield bias (percent)

name: outlier_mad_threshold
meaning: a report's residual must be within this many robust (MAD-based) standard deviations to count as verified
